source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
With **ASURYANI** as your Army Faction, you get Battle Focus tokens as each battle round starts: 2 at Incursion, 4 at Strike Force, 6 at Onslaught. Unspent tokens are lost as the round ends.

When an Agile Manoeuvre's trigger occurs, you may spend 1 token so an eligible unit performs it. A unit is eligible if it has Battle Focus and has made no Agile Manoeuvre yet this phase. Unless stated otherwise, each manoeuvre can be triggered once per phase.

- **Swift as the Wind**: when the unit is picked to make a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), Advance or Fall Back, its models get +2" Move until the phase ends. Different units may each trigger it in the same phase.
- **Flitting Shadows**: when the unit is picked to make a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), Advance or Fall Back, declares a charge, or is placed on the battlefield, enemy units cannot use [Fire Overwatch](vsdata:core-rule/fire-overwatch) against it for the rest of the turn.
- **Star Engines**: when a **VEHICLE** unit is picked to Advance, its ranged weapons get **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** for the rest of the turn.
- **Sudden Strike**: when the unit is picked to fight, its models' Pile-in and Consolidation moves that phase can each be up to 6" rather than 3".
- **Opportunity Seized**: after an enemy unit finishes Falling Back, 1 eligible non-**TITANIC** unit that began the phase in Engagement Range of it may move up to D6+1" with a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move).
- **Fade Back**: right after an enemy unit shoots in its own Shooting phase, 1 eligible non-**TITANIC** unit hit by at least one of those attacks may move up to D6+1" with a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move).

Swift as the Wind.trigger: unit selected for Normal move, Advance or Fall Back

Flitting Shadows.trigger: movement selection (Normal move, Advance or Fall Back), battlefield setup or charge declaration
Flitting Shadows.protection: enemy Fire Overwatch cannot shoot at this unit

Opportunity Seized.trigger: enemy finishes a Fall Back move
Opportunity Seized.eligibleUnit: non-Titanic, started phase within Engagement Range with that foe

Fade Back.trigger: just after enemy shoots in opposing Shooting phase
Fade Back.eligibleUnit: non-Titanic and hit at least once by those attacks
